about: When a rank's top name is settled (Steve, 2026-10-11; and 2026-10-18: one rule with the app and .org collection importance): genus and family at 0.70; species at 0.70 outright, or at 0.50 with the runner-up species strictly below 0.20. The website's answer headline (web/src/lib/answer.ts) and the API's `answer` (apiv1.mark_confident) are both tested on these cases, so they agree. `ranks` and `likely` hold [name, calibrated chance] pairs, best first; `headline` is the rank expected, or null.

cases.why: the screenshot (2026-10-18): Deconica montana 62%, the next species 7%, genus 85%: the species is the answer
cases.headline: species

cases.why: 55% against 21%: the species is not settled, the genus is the answer
cases.headline: genus

cases.why: the runner-up at exactly 20%: not settled (strictly below)
cases.headline: genus

cases.why: 49% with nothing else close: under the species minimum
cases.headline: genus

cases.why: exactly 50% with the next at 19%: settled
cases.headline: species

cases.why: the runner-up is read from the likely list too, when the ranking shows only one name (top_k 1)
cases.headline: genus

cases.why: genus still needs 70%: at 69% the family is the answer
cases.headline: family

cases.why: a genus at 60% with nothing else close is not settled: the 50% rule is for species only
